text: I installed this app for the WhatsApp chat button but ended up using a lot more features. The message templates and automation options are really helpful. Everything is easy to manage directly from Shopify.
A useful addition to our Shopify store. I like the idea of sending order updates automatically and reminding customers about abandoned checkouts without doing everything manually.
The abandoned checkout reminders are what caught my attention. Having order communication and customer follow-ups in one place can make the shopping experience smoother.
We wanted a simpler way to communicate with shoppers, and WhatsApp integration makes a lot of sense for that. The features are practical and fit well into everyday store management.
This app makes it much easier to stay connected with customers through WhatsApp. The automated messages are a useful touch, and everything feels more convenient to manage.

Excellent App with Outstanding Customer Support! WhatsApp Pilot is truly an excellent app that stands out for its high quality, great performance, and exceptional ease of use. The app is intuitive, well-designed, and incredibly easy to set up and use, even without any technical experience or assistance from the support team. Despite how user-friendly the app is, I had a few questions, and the support team was absolutely amazing! They were extremely cooperative, professional, responsive, and genuinely dedicated to answering my questions and helping me resolve everything. I highly recommend WhatsApp Pilot to anyone running an e-commerce business. It's a valuable and powerful addition to any Shopify store, helping merchants improve customer experience and communication. It absolutely deserves 5 out of 5 stars! What I like about WhatsApp Pilot is that it goes beyond just adding a WhatsApp button to my Shopify store. The Repeat Purchase feature is particularly interesting because keeping existing customers coming back is a big part of growing customer lifetime value. I also like the direction they're taking with back-in-stock alerts and discount rewards. These are the kinds of tools I actually want in one place.

The Product Demand feature is really useful. Now I can see which out of stock products customers actually want before spending money on restocking. It helps me make better purchasing decisions instead of guessing. The back in stock notifications are a nice bonus too. Great feature!
The automation feature saves us a lot of time. We can send order confirmations and updates without doing everything manually. Easy to customize the messages too. Great app so far.
Really useful app for our Shopify store. The WhatsApp widget was easy to set up and customize. Everything is simple and works as expected. Definitely recommend it.
The abandoned cart recovery sequences are probably my favorite part. Especially the option to include a discount.
